terms.gloss: an artificial helper: an AI one converses with
terms.comment: A description of ours, on the pattern of intellegentia artificiālis: adjūtor, a helper (see helper), the role these programs are given. No reference work has a word for a chatbot. In talk māchina alone is enough (see AI, a system one talks to); one that answers by voice is an adjūtor vōcālis (see voice assistant).

phrases.latin: Adjūtor artificiālis ad omnia respondet, sed nōn semper vērē.
phrases.english: The AI assistant answers everything, but not always truly.

sources: Lewis & Short: adjutor · Lewis & Short: artificialis
